_note: v2.4 plan 01 T6, RED on the pre-T6 tree (no backend). Two ST-shaped dry-run STARTEDs that are never closed (itemization/token counting: dryRun === true, the foreign-emitter fixture's dryUnpaired plus a dry quiet) arrive inside an open loud group generation with Arin drafted. A dry run is not a generation (D9): it must not take a payload capture, must not withhold the drafted member's private block, and must not open or nest anything. Pre-T6 the dry run captured a payload and a dry quiet withheld the block for the rest of the turn.

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.GROUP_MEMBER_DRAFTED, globalThis.__t6.chid); const block = String(rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock()); if (!block.includes('petty cash')) throw new Error(`drafting Arin did not stage his private block, so the probe below would measure nothing: ${JSON.stringify(block.slice(0, 300))}`); return { drafted: globalThis.__t6.chid, staged: true };
